acceptance: Gas conditioning design and commissioning samples within limits
text: At the gas turbine fuel skid inlet the gas shall meet the OEM limits and at least: total sulphur <= 30 mg S/Sm3; H2S + COS <= 5 mg/Sm3; mercury <= 1 ug/Sm3; sodium + potassium, lead, vanadium and calcium within the OEM trace-metal limits (network data below 0.005 mg/Sm3, not guaranteed by the network operator); no free liquids; particulates removed to the OEM limit (coalescing filter-separators, 3 um absolute final filtration); superheat at least 28 K above the hydrocarbon and water dew points at all loads. The Contractor shall provide continuous monitoring of H2S and total sulphur and periodic sampling points for trace metals and mercury.
title: Natural gas contaminant limits
